Unchecked corporate power blinded leadership to basic ethical boundaries and national security risks.

Confusing personal indiscretion with mere gossip while ignoring systemic national security vulnerabilities.

Exclusive extraction masked by corporate innovation pretexts. The actor traded institutional stability for personal vulnerability, exposing systemic risks.

Undone by a honey trap? Nvidia's Jensen Huang at heart of China spy scandal

=== MULTI-SOURCE TOPIC CLUSTER: Undone by a honey trap? Nvidia's Jensen Huang at heart of China spy scandal ===

[Source 1 — www.france24.com (Bias: Center / Public Broadcaster)] (URL: https://www.france24.com/en/tv-shows/the-debate/20261111-undone-by-a-honey-trap-nvidia-s-jensen-huang-at-heart-of-china-spy-scandal):
Undone by a honey trap? Nvidia's Jensen Huang at heart of China spy scandal

Turns out that the new masters of the universe are human, all too human. China accused of exploiting a vulnerability at the heart of the Silicon Valley giant that reigns supreme over two-thirds of the planet’s AI computing power production, the Nvidia co-founder tempted by the flesh. Jensen Huang admitting to an extramarital affair with Singapore-based Chinese tech CEO Alice Huang - no relation. She’s under scrutiny over the purchase of Nvidia state-of-the-art chips that may have been smuggled back to the mainland illegally. We’ll ask about the rise and possible fall of the Taiwan-born leather-clad AI world icon.

[Source 2 — www.dailymail.com (Bias: Independent / Unrated)] (URL: https://www.dailymail.com/news/article-16285603/Nvidia-Jensen-Huang-cheating-Kimberly-Powell.html?ns_mchannel=rss&ns_campaign=1490&ito=1490):
Jensen Huang caught in another cheating scandal after Chinese spy debacle as Nvidia board looks to oust CEO

Five people who worked at the chipmaker told The New York Times that Jensen Huang, 63, also had an extramarital affair with Kimberly Powell,, 48, Nvidia's vice president of healthcare.

[Source 3 — www.breitbart.com (Bias: Far Right / Populist Nationalist)] (URL: https://www.breitbart.com/tech/2026/11/11/nvidia-board-hires-ex-prosecutor-to-probe-jensen-huangs-china-spy-scandal/):
Nvidia Board Hires Former Prosecutor to Probe Jensen Huang's China Spy Scandal

Nvidia's board hired a former federal prosecutor to investigate CEO Jensen Huang's extramarital affair with a woman alleged to be a spy for China, as the company tries to manage the fallout of its scandal a week before its quarterly earnings report.
The post Nvidia Board Hires Former Prosecutor to Probe Jensen Huang’s China Spy Scandal appeared first on Breitbart.
